summary.text: John Cherry is a Democratic state senator from Michigan State Senate District 27 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 49 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: John Cherry lives in Flint, Michigan.
He earned a bachelor's degree in natural resources and environment from the University of Michigan in 2007 and a master's degree in public policy there in 2009.
His career experience includes owning Flint Coffee Company, and he served as vice chair of the Flint Charter Commission.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Clio, Michigan, and worked for nearly a decade at the Michigan Department of Natural Resources before his election to the House.
In the Senate, Cherry's 2025 and 2026 assignments include chairing the Labor Committee and serving as majority vice chair of the Natural Resources and Agriculture Committee.
He also sits on the Appropriations, Health Policy and Human Services, and Housing and Human Services committees.
